Description: Errors related to the execution of a mapping (plan) with real data
Potential Cause: Hypothesis on data may be incorrect
Potential Solution: If the data are corrcet then adapt setup to handle that case else change the data
Potential confusion: An error that could be captured with static analysis alone.

Description: The type of a data could not be converted to the target type.
Potential Cause: An ExpressionMap generates a value of a type that is not convertibe to the expected/specified type

Description: The specified rml:Source cannot be accessed/reched/does not exists.
Potential Cause: Error in the acess path or credentials

Description: Error while obtaining an iteration or iterating over a source.
Potential Cause: The reference formulation, iterator,  is incompatible

Description: Error while extracting value from Iteration

Potential confusion: This error is not for mapping file with errors in the RDF serialization format, these should be Mapping Syntax Error.

Description: The obtained data does not follow the expected format.
Errors related to the mapping defintion itself. Changin input data or configuartion will not make it work.
Potential confusion: The error is not due to the data in which case it is probably an Execution Error or Configuration Error.

Description: Error in the RDF Serialization of the mapping.
For cases when the engin does not implement part of the spec.
Potential confusion: The difference with Out Of Spec is that the engin don't know it this is spec compliant or not.

Description: Optional addittional checks by the engin for constrcut clearly out of spec unspecified or forbidden
Potential Cause: Somthing is missing in the mapping. Likely to be catched by the shapes.
Potential Solution: Change mapping or use a non compliant engin.

Description: Special case of Unsuported for functions, calling a function name without an implementation by the engin. The call may be valid.
Potential Solution: Add the implementation to the engin, setup a custom function for the engin or change engin.
Potential confusion: Not to be confused with Function Execution Error where the function itslef is implemeted but had an issue while executing.
Type Conversion Error could be an alternative when we prescisly know that's the issue.

Description: No triples map foud in the graph.
Potential Cause: Wrong prefix used or empty mapping file.
